validate_h2_diagnostics.accepted_representation: Wire-only Mapping objects with exact declared keys, lists for JSON arrays and finite JSON scalar values; None only in declared null branches. No dataclass or H2IntervalResultV2 input, no implicit record discrimination. Caller projects dataclasses explicitly: dataclasses.asdict(diagnostics) with tuple histogram converted to list; interval is None or exactly {lower: result.interval.lower, upper: result.interval.upper, level: result.interval.level}; enum reasons use .value. Never pass full asdict(PairedInterval), whose extra delta/n_psu/icc/n_boot/seed are not interval-wire keys. No import of firbench_score from contract.
validate_h2_diagnostics.context: All keyword arguments required; n_boot is positive int (not bool), from decision.interval.n_boot; level is finite non-bool number in (0,1), the actual Holm step level (.90 for reached H2). kernel_evaluated is exact bool. kernel_reason is null or one of the four h2_* method-refusal strings. verdict_reason is null or an actual v2 inconclusive-reason string; it is the H2 hypothesis reason, never a substituted overall/H1 reason. These are validation context, not knobs/defaults.
caller_context: H2-KERN tests pass actual result.reason/interval/diagnostics, kernel_evaluated=True and verdict_reason equal to kernel_reason (no later refusal).
H2-DEC retains the original kernel context and diagnostics; after a finite kernel result it may supply only later margin_unreachable_mde_gt_delta or non_confirmatory_frame as verdict_reason.

validate_scores uses h2_diagnostics presence to identify a delivered evaluated H2 result; kernel_reason is the hypothesis reason only when in the four method-refusal strings, otherwise null. For a retained finite interval, kernel_reason stays null even if verdict_reason is a later refusal. Earlier stops/not-reached have kernel_evaluated=False, null diagnostics/interval/kernel_reason, and preserve actual earlier hypothesis reason or null.
H2-CAL calls this checker per diagnostic-bearing record with explicit B/level and the same reason split. It never passes aggregate counts to this function.
validate_h2_diagnostics.returns: None on validity; pure, no mutation, IO, serialization, repair or inferred numerical acceptance.
validate_h2_diagnostics.errors: firbench_contract.FrameContractError on invalid representation, context or invariant. Diagnostic errors start 'h2_diagnostics.<field-path>:'; invalid context starts 'h2_context.<argument>:'; interval errors start 'h2_interval.<field>:'; path is stable, explanatory suffix may vary. No ValueError/KeyError/TypeError leaks for malformed payloads. Process interruptions propagate and never become a method reason.
checks: Require exactly the 12 diagnostics and 14 draw-audit keys; reject missing/unknown keys, booleans as numbers/counts, negative counts, invalid enums and every nonfinite value recursively. Exact interval keys lower/upper/level, finite bounds with lower<=upper and interval.level==level; do not clip to contrast range.

Not evaluated: diagnostics, interval and kernel_reason all null. No draw audit or method result is fabricated for an earlier refusal/H1 stop. Later MDE/frame refusal is permitted here only with an evaluated retained finite kernel interval.

Evaluated: diagnostics required. n_boot_requested==n_boot; classified+unattempted==B, classified in {0,B}; seven categories sum to classified; histogram has 8 bins with first four summing finite_t_negative and last four finite_t_positive.

Proposal §11 invariant 3: not_computed iff K<2 iff h2_paired_psu_lt_2; zero iff h2_studentized_zero_se; numeric_failure iff phase observed. These three cases classify zero with B unattempted; positive observed-SE status iff classified==B. No substantive zero from underflow.

Proposal §11 invariant 4: audit numeric_failure>0 iff phase replicate; replicate/quantile phases have both selected statuses not_computed; endpoint phase has zero audit failures and finite selected statuses. Non-none phase iff kernel_reason==h2_studentized_numeric_failure. Numeric failure precedes any infinity refusal.

Proposal §11 invariants 5/6: unbounded iff phase none, all B classified and a selected status infinite. Kernel interval nonnull iff kernel_reason null iff phase none, all B classified and both selected statuses finite. With no kernel refusal, verdict_reason may be null or the two permitted later refusals, retaining interval/diagnostics. A method refusal requires matching hypothesis reason and null interval.

Each selected rank is null iff status not_computed; otherwise exactly ceil(q*B), with q=(1-level)/2 and 1-q interpreted as decimal-rational level (Fraction(str(level))) so .90 gives 1/20 and 19/20. No B+1, interpolation, retained-subset rank or binary64-ceiling drift.

q number is null unless status finite; finite status may also have null numeric diagnostic under Rule E (an exact selected finite t may be unrepresentable). Positive observed/replicate-SE diagnostics may be null under Rule E; do not infer zero or failure from null alone. observed_se zero status emits 0; not_computed has no observed SE and emits null. For observed-phase numeric failure, only certified partial scalars may be retained under Rule E; the wire checker does not invent unavailable certification evidence or add an unsupported forced-null rule. K=0 delta null. Empty source summaries null; nonnull finite_t_min<=finite_t_max; nonnull positive_se_star_min>0. Positive-SE zero-t draws count in extrema, while histogram excludes all zero t.

Only available wire invariants are checked. Never demand per-draw tuples, exact hidden values or certification evidence that the accepted diagnostics do not carry; Rule E exact rounding remains a kernel conformance obligation.

A typed FirBenchError at the declared input validation boundary yields contract_error; distinguish it from an internal defect after validation. An escaping implementation/resource exception with no typed return yields process_incomplete, never numeric failure; neither status is scored/covered/passed. Both have null booleans/state/reason/interval/diagnostics and B/0/B. Catchable conformance interruptions may be recorded and scheduling proceeds without retry/replacement. A hard kill/host loss cannot return an envelope: absent/incomplete envelope is HOLD, never a successful calibration or an invented return. Any later incomplete-accounting receipt must attest absence, not reconstruct internal draw progress.

No fourth never-started execution status. If execution cannot start a requested packet, its record is process_incomplete with B/0/B and null result fields. Count disjoint started-incomplete and never-started subsets only if independently attested; their combined count is process_incomplete. Never double-count a never-started record in R.

calibration.errors: Existing firbench_contract.FrameContractError with 'h2_calibration.<field-path>:' prefix for malformed metadata, unknown spec/seal, mixed/duplicate/missing schedule, invalid record or reconciliation failure; no partial envelope on validation failure. aggregate_reconciliation: reconcile_calibration_v2 is pure: accepts typed records or exact wire mappings; callers explicitly project PairedInterval to {lower,upper,level}, enum strings and tuples to JSON lists. It validates each 15-key record and its explicit route/case/design/branch/index against context; it passes only per-record diagnostics to validate_h2_diagnostics with explicit context.n_boot/level and kernel-versus-verdict context. It returns the named aggregate dataclass; no IO, repair, result synthesis or hidden draw inspection.

Exactly one record at each index 1..R; execution status, reason, H2 state, interval and diagnostics marginals each sum to R; cross-count rows sum to R. completed+contract_error+process_incomplete=R. Non-completed records never increment rejection or coverage; null booleans are never coerced to false/pass.

For completed diagnostics, copy audit counts and enforce all six invariants before summing. For completed no-kernel records counts null. Error/incomplete B/0/B values contribute to draw_totals but no category/histogram/diagnostic-extrema sums. Thus category_totals sum equals draw_totals.n_boot_classified; draw requested=classified+unattempted; histogram sign sums match category totals. Never apply per-call classified in {0,B} or status/reason iff rules to branch-level sums.

Return histogram sums and min/max of available per-call extrema, with nonnull/null counts over diagnostic-bearing records and explicit diagnostics-null count. No hidden per-draw extrema reconstruction. Route/case/design/branch groups remain separate; no AU/SF pooling or winner selection.
